top_signals.title: Why Ed Yardeni Lowered His Year-End S&P 500 Target
top_signals.summary: Edward Yardeni, president at Yardeni Research, explains why he remains bullish despite lowering his year-end target on the S&P 500 to 7,500. He speaks on “Bloomberg Daybreak.” (Source: Bloomberg)
